notes.note: Neale was tagged by Touk Miller and well held to just 17 disposals. Look for him to possibly get a tag this week from Ed Allan.
Neale was massive with his best score of the season and second over 150 for the season from 35 disposals 9 tackles and 6 clearances.
Neale was one of only two Lions to hit triple figures from his 26 disposals and 7 clearances.
Neale did have 24 disposals but at just 66% efficiency which is why he didn't get a better score.
Neale was the star for the Lions from his 32 disposals where he went at 90% and had a game high 17 contested possessions. He didn't get a tag and relished the chance to run free.
Neale was big this week with 13 marks and 40 disposals. The Lions had it all their own way and Neale took full advantage of it.
Neale copped a head knock early and had to go off for a HIA which he passed. When he came back on he was released from the Mullin tag to end with 28 disposals.
Solid game for Neale without being a top end score. 27 touches and 7 clearances for him.  Just 122m gained due to 17 of those touches being handballs. Nothing to worry about here
Neale was quiet by his standards in the first half but a 37 point third term helped to change that as he was one of only three Lions over 100 this week.
This was Neale's best score of the season as he managed 37 disposals 10 clearances and 19 contested possessions. He was allowed to run as he pleased and hopefully can continue.
Neale struggled early but worked his way into the game. However he still posted his lowest score of the season.
Neale was one of just two Lions over 100 this week as he led the team in both contested possessions with 16 and 10 from his 32 disposals and 6 tackles.
Neale had the tag from Mullin but he still had 28 disposals to be the second best scorer for the Lions. Just his second under 100 in the last 7 games.

Neale topped the disposals for the game with 33 as he also took 8 marks and had 9 clearances. This makes it 5 over 110 in the last 6 for him as he is really looking a good unique pick with less than 10% of teams owning him.
Neale finished with a goal and 27 disposals but it was his first under 110 in the last five.
Huge day for Neale with 42 disposals and 13 marks after he left the game very early from a heavy bump to the chest.
Neale was one of the best for the lions in his 300th as he led the game in Contested possessions and clearances with 16 and 10. A good run of 3 games now.
Neale was the top scorer for the game with 30 disposals 20 contested disposals and 10 clearances to lead those two categories in the game.
First 100+ score since opening round for Lachie who looked a lot better this week than he has over recent games. He looked to be playing a with deal of freedom
This was a very quiet one from Neale with his 19 disposals being his lowest amount of touches for the season by 9.
Neale was still one of the best for the Lions despite the score. 28 disposals for him as he had the second most touches in the game.
Neale was the top possession getter in the game. Looked good to go for another great season.
